captions.text: Crew, take your seats. This is the last briefing before Ares VI. After this, we build humanity’s first outpost on Mars.
Four of you, one cargo-rich site in Jezero Crater. Ares V already parked supplies 400 metres from your landing zone.
Phase one. Touchdown, then habitat deployment. You have four hours, and the habitat must hold pressure before the first night.
Phase two. Fission unit plus solar array. Dust storms can last weeks, so the reactor goes up first. No power, no outpost.
Phase three. The ISRU plant pulls water from icy soil and oxygen from the CO₂ air. It also makes the propellant for your ride home.
Commander, you lead the EVA. Engineer owns power, Geologist owns the ISRU site, Medic owns the habitat and every one of you. Questions?
Launch window opens in seventy-two hours. Get some sleep. Then go build the first home we’ve ever had on another world.
